keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Charlotte FC 1, Orlando City SC 0. Henry Kessler (Charlotte FC) header from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ashley Westwood with a cross following a set piece situation.
Iago Teodoro (Orlando City SC) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Orlando City SC. Eduard Atuesta replaces Luis Otávio.
Substitution, Orlando City SC. Adrián Marín replaces Vinícius Nogueira.
Goal! Charlotte FC 2, Orlando City SC 0. Allan Saint-Maximin (Charlotte FC) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Harry Toffolo.
Ashley Westwood (Charlotte FC) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Orlando City SC. Justin Ellis replaces Zakaria Taifi.
Substitution, Orlando City SC. Harvey Sarajian replaces Marco Pasalic.
Substitution, Charlotte FC. Luca de la Torre replaces Ashley Westwood.
Substitution, Orlando City SC. Daryl Dike replaces Braian Ojeda.
Delay in match because of an injury Liel Abada (Charlotte FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Charlotte FC. Rodolfo Aloko replaces Liel Abada because of an injury.
Delay in match because of an injury Morrison Agyemang (Charlotte FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Charlotte FC. Tyger Smalls replaces Idan Toklomati because of an injury.
Substitution, Charlotte FC. Abdoulaye Doucouré replaces Djibril Diani.
Iván Angulo (Orlando City SC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Penalty saved. Allan Saint-Maximin (Charlotte FC) right footed shot saved in the bottom left corner by Maxime Crépeau (Orlando City SC).
Goal! Charlotte FC 3, Orlando City SC 0. Abdoulaye Doucouré (Charlotte FC) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner following a set piece situation.
Allan Saint-Maximin (Charlotte FC) is shown the red card.
Tyger Smalls (Charlotte FC) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Charlotte FC 4, Orlando City SC 0. Rodolfo Aloko (Charlotte FC) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Tyger Smalls with a cross.
Second Half ends, Charlotte FC 4, Orlando City SC 0.
